topic: Channeling a firehorse child's energy through sports, performing arts, and one pocket of calm -- five practical moves for parents this weekend.
phrases: Channel the fire. Don't fight it.
The fire is not the problem. The direction is the question.
One outlet. One pocket of calm. That is enough.

images.concept: A child running across an open field at golden hour, shot from behind and low to the ground, so the child appears against a wide golden sky. The child is in full sprint, arms pumping, completely committed to the movement. In the far distance, barely visible, a tree line in soft jade green. The image is joy and direction at the same time.
images.prompt: A child running at full sprint across an open field at golden hour, photographed from behind and low to the ground, the child silhouetted against a wide warm gold sky. Arms pumping, feet barely touching the grass. The field is deep jade green, the sky antique gold fading to warm ivory at the horizon. A distant tree line is barely visible. No one is chasing the child; they are simply running, completely in it. Cinematic, slightly wide angle, shot from child height. The overall feeling is pure forward momentum and joy. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A weathered wooden arrow sign, aged and warm, pointing to the right against a soft blurred garden background. The arrow is a single object in the frame, simple and definitive. It points. It does not waver. The metaphor: direction is everything. The fire needs somewhere to go.
images.prompt: A single weathered wooden arrow, aged and warm-toned, pointing to the right, mounted against a blurred deep jade garden background. The arrow is the only object in the frame. The wood is old and beautiful, slightly cracked, with antique gold tones in the grain. Natural morning light from the upper left. The background is soft-focus jade green. The image is clean and deliberate -- one direction, committed. No text, no typography. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A close-up of a small child's hands holding a worn red rubber ball, both hands wrapped around it with total commitment. The background is blurred sage green. The hands are small, the grip is earnest, the ball is slightly scuffed. This is the moment before throwing, before the release -- the energy fully gathered and about to go somewhere.
images.prompt: Square close-up of a small child's hands, both wrapped around a worn red rubber ball. The grip is full-commitment, slightly too big for the hands, the ball just barely contained. The background is soft blurred sage green. Natural warm light from the upper left. The ball is slightly scuffed and real-looking, not toy-bright. The image captures the moment before release -- energy fully gathered. Palette: warm ivory skin tones, deep crimson ball, soft sage green background. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.prompt: A square affirmation card, 1080x1080. Warm cream paper background with a soft aged texture -- subtle deckle edges on the top and right, a single faint tea-stain ring in the lower right corner, one folded corner top-left catching gentle shadow.
